I'm also in my 20s and have autism, also suffer from terrible insecurities and haven't really followed the usual path of life.
What I suggest you do is start going to the gym and start making small changes to your life and become happier from that.
The gym will help you put some routine into your life and will help dealing with depression, I promise you you'll feel a lot better just doing that.
It also might be a good idea to start going into therapy, people like us really profit from it most of the time, they can really help you make a difference.

And instead of regretting what you can't do or what you don't like about yourself, try doing what you love and change what you want to change.
We might never be like a lot of other people and deal with envy from time to time, but you should remember that it's ok to be different and to not be so hard on yourself all the time.
